problems.what: corpus/round-0045.json r45_kelvin_age_of_earth_1897 truth.why: «سن‌سنجیِ پرتوزا سنِ زمین را ۴٫۵۴ ± ۰٫۰۵ میلیارد سال نشان داد (پترسون ۱۹۵۶)» is a misattribution. Patterson (1956, Geochim. Cosmochim. Acta 10:230–237) reported 4.55 ± 0.07 Gyr; 4.54 ± 0.05 Gyr is the modern USGS/Dalrymple value. The case's own cited page says so: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Age_of_Earth — lead: 'estimated to be 4.54 ± 0.05 billion years' (USGS 1997); section Use of meteorites: 'An age of 4.55 ± 0.07 billion years, very close to today's accepted age, was determined by Clair Cameron Patterson ... published in 1956'.
problems.fix: رقمِ پترسون در truth.why اصلاح شد (۴٫۵۵ ± ۰٫۰۷؛ امروز ۴٫۵۴ ± ۰٫۰۵)

problems.what: corpus/round-0045.json r45_kelvin_age_of_earth_1897 story: the sentence «در حسابش نه منبعِ گرمای دیگری در درونِ زمین بود و نه جابه‌جاییِ ماده در ژرفا» lists, in negative form, exactly the two things later shown to matter (radioactivity; mantle convection — England, Molnar & Richter 2007). problems.fix: جملهٔ «نه… نه…» برداشته و الگو به زبانِ خودِ کلوین گفته شد؛ منبعِ ۱۸۶۳ ِ خودِ کلوین افزوده شد؛ بازرمزگذاریِ کورِ دوم (f همان ماند)

problems.what: corpus/round-0045.json r45_sacromonte_lead_books_1595 story: «هر دو [آلونسو دل کاستیو و میگل د لونا] در پیدا شدنِ بخشی از کتاب‌ها هم دست داشتند» and truth.why «تنها راهِ فهمِ متن مترجمانی بودند که خود در یافتنِ کتاب‌ها دست داشتند». The only basis is one sentence of the cited Wikipedia article ('had indeed been instrumental in the rediscovery of some of the books'), which is unreferenced in an article tagged 'more footnotes needed / original research'. Scholarly accounts say the plomos were found by treasure hunters on Valparaíso hill in 1595 (Granada municipal archive, UGR journals; Harris 2007), and Luna/Castillo are suspected as authors, not recorded as finders; other translators (Diego de Urrea, López Tamarid, Arias Montano consulted) were also used, so 'only way' is overstated. Besides being weakly sourced, the sentence is a pointing phrase: it hands the encoder the conflict of interest (encoder set x_bias:true, narrator unknown) and it is not shown that Castro knew this when he judged.
problems.fix: داستان و why بازنویسی شد: یابندگان = گنج‌جویان؛ «بیشتر به دو مترجم تکیه داشت»؛ منبعِ García-Arenal & Rodríguez Mediano افزوده شد؛ بازرمزگذاریِ کور

problems.what: corpus/round-0045.json r45_sacromonte_lead_books_1595 story also contains «غرناطه تا ۱۴۹۲ در دستِ مسلمانان بود و کلیسایش با این یافته‌ها پیشینه‌ای از سدهٔ نخست و قدیسی بنیان‌گذار پیدا می‌کرد» — true, but it is the collector's explanation of the motive, placed in the story so that bg_undue becomes readable (encoder set bg_undue:true). problems.what: corpus/round-0045.json r45_will_rogers_stage_migration_1985: the title shown to the blind encoder is «بقای بهترِ هر مرحلهٔ سرطانِ ریه و «پدیدهٔ ویل راجرز» (۱۹۸۵)» — it names the artifact that is the answer (Feinstein's term for stage migration producing misleading survival statistics). problems.what: corpus/round-0045.json r45_shroud_turin_radiocarbon_1988 story: «به گزارشِ خودِ پژوهش، نتیجه‌های سه آزمایشگاه با هم سازگار بود» overstates Damon et al. 1989. The paper reports excellent agreement for the three control samples but for the Shroud sample a chi-square of 6.4 (2 d.f., about the 5% level) and says the spread for sample 1 is somewhat greater than expected from the quoted errors, which is why an unweighted mean with enlarged error was used; its own conclusion is 'conclusive evidence that the linen of the Shroud of Turin is mediaeval' (Nature 337:611–615 abstract). Re-analyses of the raw data (Casabianca et al. 2019, Archaeometry 61:1223–31; Wikipedia 'Radiocarbon dating of the Shroud of Turin') find the inter-laboratory data heterogeneous and say the stated 95% range cannot be called conclusive for the whole cloth, while not ruling out a medieval date. So 'sound' is fair for «پارچه از سده‌های میانه است» but less clearly for the exact «۱۲۶۰–۱۳۹۰ با اطمینانِ ۹۵٪»; truth.why mentions the heterogeneity criticism but asserts none of the criticisms matters. Other facts verified (21 April 1988; Arizona/Oxford/Zurich; British Museum; 13 Oct 1988; first certain appearance 1350s).
problems.fix: داستان به گفتهٔ خودِ مقاله بازنویسی شد (پراکندگیِ بیشتر از خطای اعلام‌شده)؛ تصدیق به «سده‌های میانه» محدود شد؛ why بازتحلیلِ Casabianca 2019 را می‌گوید؛ بازرمزگذاریِ کور

problems.what: samples/round-0045.json ioannidis2005_highly_cited — outcome-correlated wording in item texts. Extra design caveats were added to exactly five items, all of them 'contradicted' or 'initially stronger' and none of the 20 'replicated': io07 «(۲۰۰ بیمار)», io43 «(۲۰۰۲ بیمار)», io14 «مجموعهٔ ۹ بیمار», io40 «روی ۸۰۵ مردِ سالمند», io34 «(سنجشِ نشانگرهای جانشین)». Replicated items with equally small samples carry no number (Brown 1990 n=146, Moertel 1990 n=246, PAMI n=395, Castaigne 1990 n=22 — Table 1). The numbers echo Box 1 of the paper, which is written after the outcome. The blind encoder noticed them (enc_note on io07, io14, io34, io40, io43). In this round they did not change any f (all RCTs got vazraf/hidden_ctrl true, all nonrandomized false), so the measured base is unaffected, but the frame text is not outcome-neutral and would bias any future feature that reads sample size or surrogate endpoints.
problems.fix: متنِ هر ۳۳ موردِ قاب در یک قالبِ یکسان (طرح، شمارِ نمونهٔ Table 1، ارجاع، جهتِ اثر) بازنویسی و با رمزگذارِ کورِ دوم از نو رمز شد

problems.what: samples/round-0045.json — the measured base p_hidden_factor (74.95 → 42.9; n=5 groups, ok=2; (2+1)/(5+2)=42.9, interval 11.8–76.9) follows arithmetically from the data, but both 'true' and one 'false' depend on judgment calls: (1) io40 Hertog 1993 is counted true on the strength of Huxley & Neil 2003, a meta-analysis of prospective cohorts — the same uncontrolled design (Table 2: 'MA cohorts'); no randomized evidence settled it, so its 'fate' is not determined by better-controlled research (Ioannidis: subsequent studies 'either larger or better controlled'); (2) io14 Rossaint 1993 is counted false although the claim actually made and measured (better oxygenation) was not refuted — the item text itself adds «(اکسیژن‌رسانی را بهتر می‌کند)»; Ioannidis' Table 2 says 'Despite initial claims of better oxygenation, nitric oxide does not improve survival', and the original authors wrote that randomized trials were needed to see whether outcome improves. With Hertog set aside the value is (1+1)/(4+2)=33.3; with Rossaint read as true it is 57.1. The frame's caveats list does not mention either point.
problems.fix: Hertog 1993 (io40) به skipped رفت (سرانجامش با پژوهشِ هم‌طرح سنجیده شده)؛ متنِ io14 فقط ادعای کارایی را می‌گوید؛ هر چهار حساسیت در caveats ثبت شد

problems.what: samples/round-0045.json io01 (ACTG019): text «زیدوودین در آلودگیِ بی‌نشانهٔ HIV-1 پیشرفتِ بیماری را کند می‌کند» is marked true, but Ioannidis' own verdict is that the benefit was short-lived and 'lost after 18 months both in the same trial and … in a subsequent meta-analysis' (Box 1). problems.what: findings.json — two fixed→verified transitions rest on weak fresh tests (tool rule: ≥3 fresh, all 'ok'). f_r44_mobible_dss_fragments_2009 (a claim mixing sellers' testimony with scholars' attribution, mislocated to st_expert; fix = split the claim) is 'verified' one round later by r45_parmalat, r45_sun, r45_sacromonte and the two abstract twins. Four of the five are pure-testimony cases that could not have reproduced the mix-up, two of them are twins derived from two of the others (3 independent cases, not 5), and the only case with the same mixed structure — Sacromonte (translators as interested experts + testimony in one unsplit claim) — in fact shows the same pattern again: engine flagged st_naql+st_expert+st_background against a label of st_naql+st_background, counted 'ok' only because extra stations do not count. f_r42_dehn_lemma_1910 (a gap inside a proof that the story could not state without leaking) is 'verified' by r44_tractatus, r44_people_v_collins, r45_descartes, r45_kelvin and r45_ventris: Ventris is a sound non-deductive case (tests only absence of false alarm), and in the others the story spells the unproven premises out, so none tests the hard situation of the finding (a subtle flawed step in a proof). The record is also self-contradictory: it has a fix dated round 43 and a resolvedNote «بدونِ اصلاحِ ثبت‌شده درست شد».
problems.fix: ملاکِ verified ِ ابزار تصمیمِ مالک است ⇒ افزوده به پیشنهادِ p_partial_location_findings؛ در note ِ هر دو یافته نوشته شد که تأییدِ ابزار با وقایعِ هم‌ساختار پشتیبانی نشده
